verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions handwriting recognition or per-field confidence scores for uncertain extractions. Structured extraction with bounding-box citations and Track Changes extraction of comments from scans are related features, but neither covers recognizing handwritten fields or flagging low-confidence results. This is a fair question for a document OCR product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain
